correctness.rationale: An exact support-update identity proves decreasing occupied palettes; every maximal cyclic run loses its predecessor endpoint each step and cannot merge, giving tau=max run-1. A full palette rotates with least period q. Occupied run-avoidance has a unique cyclic automaton state path, and exponential surjection weighting gives the complete cumulative EGF. The rare-missing-color estimate follows by inclusion-exclusion. Exhaustive direct simulation (218210 states) and a separate 33-case polynomial transfer/subset comparison corroborate the proof.
